title: Time & Calendar
description: Class 1 IMO — Time & Calendar: day and night, days of the week, months and seasons, and reading o'clock time, with reasoning and everyday-maths practice.

topics.title: Day, Night and Days of the Week
topics.concept:
The Sun is up in the day and we see the Moon and stars at night. We eat breakfast in the morning, lunch in the afternoon and dinner at night.

There are 7 days in a week: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday.

examples.problem: Do we see the Sun in the day or at night?

recap: Day = Sun is up; night = Moon and stars.
A week has 7 days, starting Sunday.

quiz.q: How many days are there in a week?
Which day comes just before Sunday?

topics.title: Months and Seasons
topics.concept:
There are 12 months in a year, from January to December. Some months we know well: January is first and December is last.

India has seasons such as summer (hot), the rainy season (wet) and winter (cold).

examples.problem: How many months are in a year?
In which season do we use umbrellas the most?

recap: A year has 12 months (January to December).
Seasons include summer, rainy season and winter.

quiz.q: How many months are there in a year?
quiz.explanation: There are 12 months in a year.

quiz.q: Which is the first month of the year?

topics.title: Reading Time (O'clock)
topics.concept: A clock has two hands. The short hand shows the hour and the long hand shows the minutes. When the long hand points to 12, we say 'o'clock'. If the short hand points to 3 and the long hand to 12, the time is 3 o'clock.

examples.problem: The short hand is on 8 and the long hand on 12. What is the time?
Which hand is longer — the hour hand or the minute hand?

recap: Short hand = hour; long hand = minutes.
Long hand on 12 means it is 'o'clock'.

quiz.q: The short hand points to 5 and the long hand to 12. What is the time?
quiz.explanation: Short hand on 5, long hand on 12 means 5 o'clock.

quiz.q: We usually eat breakfast in the ___ ?
quiz.explanation: Breakfast is eaten in the morning.

questions.q: Which day is the odd one out:  Monday, Tuesday, January, Friday?
questions.explanation: January is a month; the others are days of the week.

questions.q: Complete the order:  Monday, Tuesday, ___, Thursday
questions.explanation: Wednesday comes between Tuesday and Thursday.

questions.q: Sun is to day as Moon is to ___ ?
questions.explanation: We see the Sun by day and the Moon at night.

questions.q: How many days are in a week?
How many months are in a year?
The short hand is on 9 and the long hand on 12. The time is ___ ?
Which month comes just after June?
In which season do we wear warm sweaters?
questions.explanation: We wear sweaters in winter because it is cold.

questions.q: Today is Wednesday. What day will it be after 2 days?
questions.explanation: Wednesday → Thursday → Friday. After 2 days it is Friday.

questions.q: It is 7 o'clock now. What time will it be 3 hours later?
